title: Windows PowerShell Command Delimiter Normalization

claims.assertion: Command chaining using POSIX '&&' fails unconditionally in Windows PowerShell environments with ParserError; automated CLI runners and scripts must normalize command chains to semicolons ';' or isolated subprocess arrays

context: Agents generating shell execution plans often default to Unix POSIX conventions (&&, /tmp, export), which crash when dispatched directly to Windows PowerShell runners.
distilled_learning: Sanitize all multi-command CLI sequences for Windows hosts: replace '&&' with ';', use platform-agnostic path resolvers (Pathlib or %TEMP%), and prefer Python script runners for complex chained logic.
